title: Two-transitive translation designs of Boolean bent functions
summary: Classify Boolean bent functions whose translation designs have 2-transitive automorphism groups by the proposed degree-three Maiorana-McFarland EA class.

formal_statement.body: Let $n$ be even and let $f:\mathbb F_2^n\to\mathbb F_2$ be bent. Prove or refute that $\operatorname{Aut}(\operatorname{dev}(D_f))$ is 2-transitive if and only if $f$ is EA-equivalent to a Maiorana--McFarland function $$f_0(x,y)=x\cdot y+g(y),\qquad x,y\in\mathbb F_2^{n/2},\quad \deg(g)\le 3.$$

scope.domain: Automorphism groups of translation designs derived from Boolean bent functions
assumptions: $f$ is a Boolean bent function on $\mathbb F_2^n$
$D_f$ is the source-defined difference set and $\operatorname{dev}(D_f)$ its translation design
EA-equivalence and the Maiorana--McFarland form use the source conventions
parameters: $g:\mathbb F_2^{n/2}\to\mathbb F_2$ with degree at most three
scope.unresolved_remainder: Establish both implications for every even n and every Boolean bent function, or give a counterexample to either implication.

progress.summary: The source conjectures an exact EA-classification of Boolean bent functions whose translation designs have 2-transitive automorphism groups.
